verified_fact: Basic DXCC requires working and confirming at least 100 DXCC entities; Mixed permits any mode and qualifying contacts date from 1945-11-15.
LoTW provides a DXCC award-credit application path; local threshold is not sponsor credit.
Basic WAS requires confirmed contacts with all 50 U.S. states; 60m is excluded and DC may count for Maryland.
ARRL publishes current WAS application forms; LoTW/hybrid methods are separately supported.
WAC requires working and confirming North America, South America, Oceania, Asia, Europe and Africa.
The official page publishes the WAC application/checking process and forms.
Triple Play WAS requires LoTW-confirmed QSOs with all 50 states on voice, CW and digital; contacts must be after 2009-01-01 and 60m is excluded.
The award is based on an electronic LoTW application; a local 150-cell count alone is not sponsor claimability.
IOTA 100 is the basic award: at least 100 confirmed IOTA groups with different references and at least one contact from each of seven continents.
IOTA submissions are made through the official online programme/database under current rules.
Bronze Hunter requires hunting 10 unique POTA references; unique-reference awards are issued automatically after qualifying logs are processed.
Chasers/SWLs reach Shack Sloth at 1000 SOTA points; awards are not sent automatically and must be claimed.
SOTA programme scoring/operation remains governed by the current General Rules and local association rules.
